select cast(null as char(16)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as source, cast(null as char(64)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as type, cast(null as char(16)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as category, cast(null as signed) as business_id, cast(null as char(128)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as business_no, cast(null as char(255)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, cast(null as char(500)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, cast(null as char(32)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as status, cast(null as char(16)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as priority, cast(null as datetime) as created_time, cast(null as signed) as waiting_seconds, cast(null as signed) as dept_id, cast(null as char(128)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, cast(null as char(32)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, cast(null as char(32)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as scope_mode, cast(null as char(32)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as route_type, cast(null as char(128)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as required_permission, cast(1 as signed) as count_value from dual where 1 = 0
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_TRANSFER_APPROVAL' as type, 'approval' as category, o.transfer_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat(case o.transfer_type when 'warehouse' then '门店要货待审批' when 'store_return' then '门店返仓待审批' when 'cross_store' then '异店调货待审批' else '调拨待审批' end, '：', o.order_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat_ws(' → ', o.from_dept_name, o.to_dept_name) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.status as status, case when timestampdiff(second, coalesce(t.create_time, i.create_time, o.submitted_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp) >= #{approvalUrgentHours} * 3600 then 'urgent' else 'important' end as priority, coalesce(t.create_time, i.create_time, o.submitted_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(t.create_time, i.create_time, o.submitted_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'approve' as route_type, 'inv:transfer:approve' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_transfer_order o inner join inv_transfer_approval_instance i on i.instance_id = coalesce( o.approval_instance_id, (select max(fallback_i.instance_id) from inv_transfer_approval_instance fallback_i where fallback_i.transfer_id = o.transfer_id and fallback_i.status = 'running') ) and i.transfer_id = o.transfer_id and i.status = 'running' inner join inv_transfer_approval_task t on t.instance_id = i.instance_id and t.transfer_id = o.transfer_id and t.status = 'pending' and t.node_order = i.current_node_order inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = ( select min(visible_dept.dept_id) from sys_dept visible_dept where visible_dept.dept_id in ( o.from_dept_id, o.to_dept_id, o.from_warehouse_id, o.to_warehouse_id )
) where o.status = 'submitted' and coalesce(o.approval_engine, 'LEGACY') = 'LEGACY' and find_in_set(#{userId}, t.candidate_user_ids) and ( coalesce(i.allow_self_approve, '0') = '1' or coalesce(o.create_by, '') <> coalesce(#{username}, '') )
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_STOCK_CHECK_APPROVAL' as type, 'approval' as category, s.check_id as business_id, s.check_no as business_no, concat('盘点审批：', s.check_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat('差异数量：', coalesce(ai.total_abs_diff_quantity, 0)) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, s.status as status, case when timestampdiff(second, coalesce(at.create_time, ai.submitted_time, ai.create_time, s.submitted_time, s.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp) >= #{approvalUrgentHours} * 3600 then 'urgent' else 'important' end as priority, coalesce(at.create_time, ai.submitted_time, ai.create_time, s.submitted_time, s.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(at.create_time, ai.submitted_time, ai.create_time, s.submitted_time, s.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'approve' as route_type, 'inv:stockCheck:approve' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_stock_check s inner join inv_stock_check_approval_instance ai on ai.instance_id = coalesce( s.approval_instance_id, (select fallback_ai.instance_id from inv_stock_check_approval_instance fallback_ai where fallback_ai.check_id = s.check_id and fallback_ai.status = 'running' order by fallback_ai.round_no desc, fallback_ai.instance_id desc limit 1) ) and ai.check_id = s.check_id and ai.status = 'running' inner join inv_stock_check_approval_task at on at.instance_id = ai.instance_id and at.check_id = s.check_id and at.status = 'pending' inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id where s.status = 'pending_approval' and coalesce(s.approval_engine, 'LEGACY') = 'LEGACY' and find_in_set(#{userId}, at.candidate_user_ids) and exists ( select 1 from sys_user u inner join sys_user_post up on up.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_post p on p.post_id = up.post_id inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id inner join sys_user_shop us on us.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id inner join sys_dept target_dept on target_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and p.status = '0' and p.post_code = 'yyzj' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and m.status = '0' and m.perms = 'inv:stockCheck:approve' and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and ( target_dept.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, target_dept.ancestors) ) )
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_PURCHASE_QC' as type, 'execution' as category, o.order_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat('采购质检：', o.order_title) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat_ws(' · ', o.supplier_name, context_dept.dept_name, case when pending_inbound.purchase_order_id is null then '待检记录缺失，请联系管理员' else null end) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.qc_status as status, 'normal' as priority, coalesce(pending_inbound.created_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(pending_inbound.created_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'quality_check' as route_type, 'inv:purchase:qc' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_purchase_order o left join ( select inbound.purchase_order_id, coalesce(inbound.warehouse_id, inbound.shop_dept_id) as context_dept_id, min(inbound.create_time) as created_time from inv_inbound_record inbound where inbound.qc_result = 'pending' group by inbound.purchase_order_id, coalesce(inbound.warehouse_id, inbound.shop_dept_id) ) pending_inbound on pending_inbound.purchase_order_id = o.order_id inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = coalesce(pending_inbound.context_dept_id, o.shop_dept_id) where o.status = 'submitted' and o.qc_status = 'pending'
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_PURCHASE_RECEIVE' as type, 'execution' as category, o.order_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat('采购收货：', o.order_title) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat('待收数量：', detail_summary.remaining_quantity) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.status as status, 'normal' as priority, coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'receive' as route_type, 'inv:purchase:receive' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_purchase_order o inner join ( select d.order_id, sum(coalesce(d.quantity, 0) - coalesce(d.received_quantity, 0)) as remaining_quantity from inv_purchase_detail d group by d.order_id ) detail_summary on detail_summary.order_id = o.order_id inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = o.shop_dept_id where o.status = 'submitted' and detail_summary.remaining_quantity > 0 and coalesce(o.qc_status, '') <> 'pending'
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_SALES_NOTICE_CREATE' as type, 'execution' as category, o.order_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat('创建发货通知：', o.order_title) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat('待通知数量：', detail_summary.remaining_quantity) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.status as status, 'normal' as priority, coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'create_notice' as route_type, 'inv:deliveryNotice:add' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_sales_order o inner join ( select d.order_id, sum(coalesce(d.quantity, 0) - coalesce(d.delivered_quantity, 0)) as remaining_quantity from inv_sales_detail d group by d.order_id ) detail_summary on detail_summary.order_id = o.order_id inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = o.shop_dept_id where o.status = 'submitted' and detail_summary.remaining_quantity > 0 and not exists ( select 1 from inv_delivery_notice active_notice where active_notice.sales_order_id = o.order_id and active_notice.status in ('pending', 'delivering') )
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_DELIVERY_EXECUTE' as type, 'execution' as category, n.notice_id as business_id, n.notice_no as business_no, concat('执行发货：', n.notice_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat('待发数量：', detail_summary.remaining_quantity) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, n.status as status, 'normal' as priority, coalesce(n.update_time, n.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(n.update_time, n.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'deliver' as route_type, 'inv:deliveryNotice:deliver' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_delivery_notice n inner join ( select nd.notice_id, sum(coalesce(nd.notice_qty, 0) - coalesce(nd.delivered_qty, 0)) as remaining_quantity from inv_delivery_notice_detail nd group by nd.notice_id ) detail_summary on detail_summary.notice_id = n.notice_id inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = ( select min(scoped_sd.warehouse_id) from inv_delivery_notice_detail scoped_nd inner join inv_sales_detail scoped_sd on scoped_sd.detail_id = scoped_nd.sales_detail_id where scoped_nd.notice_id = n.notice_id and scoped_sd.warehouse_id is not null and coalesce(scoped_nd.notice_qty, 0) - coalesce(scoped_nd.delivered_qty, 0) > 0
) where n.status in ('pending', 'delivering') and detail_summary.remaining_quantity > 0
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_TRANSFER_SOURCE_CONFIRM' as type, 'execution' as category, o.transfer_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat('异店调货待调出店确认：', o.order_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat_ws(' → ', o.from_dept_name, o.to_dept_name) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.status as status, 'important' as priority, coalesce(o.approved_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(o.approved_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'source_confirm' as route_type, 'inv:transfer:deliver' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_transfer_order o inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = coalesce( o.from_warehouse_id, o.from_dept_id) where o.transfer_type = 'cross_store' and coalesce(o.source_business_type, '') <> 'sales_delivery' and o.status = 'approved' and coalesce(o.source_confirm_status, 'PENDING') = 'PENDING'
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_TRANSFER_DELIVER' as type, 'execution' as category, o.transfer_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat(case o.transfer_type when 'warehouse' then '门店要货待发货' when 'store_return' then '门店返仓待发货' when 'cross_store' then '异店调货待发货' else '调拨待发货' end, '：', o.order_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat_ws(' → ', o.from_dept_name, o.to_dept_name) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.status as status, 'normal' as priority, coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'deliver' as route_type, 'inv:transfer:deliver' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_transfer_order o inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = ( select min(visible_dept.dept_id) from sys_dept visible_dept where visible_dept.dept_id in (o.from_dept_id, o.from_warehouse_id)
) where o.status in ('approved', 'reserved', 'partial_delivered') and ( o.transfer_type <> 'cross_store' or coalesce(o.source_business_type, '') = 'sales_delivery' or o.source_confirm_status in ('CONFIRMED', 'PARTIAL') )
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_TRANSFER_RECEIVE' as type, 'execution' as category, sh.shipment_id as business_id, concat_ws(' / ', o.order_no, sh.shipment_no) as business_no, concat(case o.transfer_type when 'warehouse' then '门店要货待收货' when 'store_return' then '门店返仓待收货' when 'cross_store' then '异店调货待收货' else '调拨待收货' end, '：', sh.shipment_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat_ws(' → ', o.from_dept_name, o.to_dept_name) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, sh.status as status, 'normal' as priority, coalesce(sh.create_time, sh.shipped_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(sh.create_time, sh.shipped_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'receive_shipment' as route_type, 'inv:transfer:receive' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_transfer_shipment sh inner join inv_transfer_order o on o.transfer_id = sh.transfer_id inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = ( select min(visible_dept.dept_id) from sys_dept visible_dept where visible_dept.dept_id in (o.to_warehouse_id, o.to_dept_id)
) where sh.status = 'pending_receive'
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_TRANSFER_DISCREPANCY' as type, 'execution' as category, o.transfer_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat(case o.transfer_type when 'warehouse' then '门店要货差异待处理' when 'store_return' then '门店返仓差异待处理' when 'cross_store' then '异店调货差异待处理' else '调拨差异待处理' end, '：', o.order_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat('短少 ', discrepancy.shortage_quantity, ' / 拒收 ', discrepancy.rejected_quantity, ' / 残损 ', discrepancy.damaged_quantity) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.status as status, 'important' as priority, coalesce(discrepancy.create_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(discrepancy.create_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'handle_discrepancy' as route_type, 'inv:transfer:discrepancy:handle' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_transfer_order o inner join ( select d.transfer_id, min(d.create_time) as create_time, sum(coalesce(d.shortage_quantity, 0)) as shortage_quantity, sum(coalesce(d.rejected_quantity, 0)) as rejected_quantity, sum(coalesce(d.damaged_quantity, 0)) as damaged_quantity from inv_transfer_discrepancy d where d.status in ('OPEN', 'PENDING_QC') group by d.transfer_id ) discrepancy on discrepancy.transfer_id = o.transfer_id inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = ( select min(visible_dept.dept_id) from sys_dept visible_dept where visible_dept.dept_id in (o.to_warehouse_id, o.to_dept_id)
) where o.status = 'discrepancy'
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_PURCHASE_RETURN_CONFIRM' as type, 'execution' as category, r.return_id as business_id, r.return_no as business_no, concat('确认采购退货：', r.return_title) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat_ws(' · ', r.purchase_order_no, r.supplier_name) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, r.status as status, 'important' as priority, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'confirm_return' as route_type, 'inv:purchaseReturn:confirm' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_purchase_return r inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = r.shop_dept_id where r.status = 'submitted' and exists ( select 1 from inv_purchase_return_detail rd where rd.return_id = r.return_id and coalesce(rd.quantity, 0) - coalesce(rd.returned_quantity, 0) > 0 )
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_SALES_RETURN_CONFIRM' as type, 'execution' as category, r.return_id as business_id, r.return_no as business_no, concat('确认销售退货：', r.return_title) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat_ws(' · ', r.sales_order_no, r.customer_name) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, r.status as status, 'important' as priority, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'confirm_return' as route_type, 'inv:salesReturn:confirm' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_sales_return r inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = r.shop_dept_id where r.status = 'submitted' and exists ( select 1 from inv_sales_return_detail rd where rd.return_id = r.return_id and coalesce(rd.quantity, 0) - coalesce(rd.returned_quantity, 0) > 0 )
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_TRANSFER_RETURNED' as type, 'returned' as category, o.transfer_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat(case o.transfer_type when 'warehouse' then '门店要货已退回' when 'store_return' then '门店返仓已退回' when 'cross_store' then '异店调货已退回' else '调拨已退回' end, '：', o.order_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, coalesce(nullif(rejected_instance.remark, ''), '审批驳回，请修改后重新提交') collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.status as status, 'important' as priority, coalesce(rejected_instance.update_time, rejected_instance.create_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(rejected_instance.update_time, rejected_instance.create_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'revise' as route_type,
cast(null as char) as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_transfer_order o inner join inv_transfer_approval_instance rejected_instance on rejected_instance.instance_id = coalesce( o.approval_instance_id, (select max(fallback_i.instance_id) from inv_transfer_approval_instance fallback_i where fallback_i.transfer_id = o.transfer_id) ) and rejected_instance.transfer_id = o.transfer_id and rejected_instance.status = 'rejected' inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = case when o.transfer_type = 'store_return' or o.source_business_type = 'oe_replenishment' then coalesce(o.from_dept_id, o.from_warehouse_id) else coalesce(o.to_dept_id, o.to_warehouse_id) end where o.status = 'draft' and coalesce(o.approval_engine, 'LEGACY') = 'LEGACY' and o.create_by = #{username} and not exists ( select 1 from inv_transfer_approval_instance newer_instance where newer_instance.transfer_id = o.transfer_id and newer_instance.instance_id > rejected_instance.instance_id )
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_TRANSFER_RETURNED' as type, 'returned' as category, o.transfer_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat(case o.transfer_type when 'warehouse' then '门店要货已退回' when 'store_return' then '门店返仓已退回' when 'cross_store' then '异店调货已退回' else '调拨已退回' end, '：', o.order_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, coalesce(nullif(return_log.reason, ''), '审批退回，请修改后重新提交') collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.status as status, 'important' as priority, coalesce(return_log.create_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(return_log.create_time, o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'revise' as route_type, cast(null as char) as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_transfer_order o left join inv_transfer_status_log return_log on return_log.log_id = ( select max(candidate_log.log_id) from inv_transfer_status_log candidate_log where candidate_log.transfer_id = o.transfer_id and candidate_log.action = 'return' ) inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = case when o.transfer_type = 'store_return' or o.source_business_type = 'oe_replenishment' then coalesce(o.from_dept_id, o.from_warehouse_id) else coalesce(o.to_dept_id, o.to_warehouse_id) end where o.status = 'draft' and upper(coalesce(o.approval_engine, '')) = 'NATIVE' and right(o.last_approval_event_key, 7) = ':RETURN' and o.create_by = #{username}
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_TRANSFER_SOURCE_RESELECT' as type, 'returned' as category, o.transfer_id as business_id, o.order_no as business_no, concat('异店调货待重选调出店：', o.order_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, coalesce(nullif(o.remark, ''), '调出店未全量确认，请重新选择其他调出店') collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, o.status as status, 'important' as priority, coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'revise' as route_type, cast(null as char) as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_transfer_order o inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = coalesce( o.to_warehouse_id, o.to_dept_id) where o.transfer_type = 'cross_store' and o.status = 'draft' and o.source_confirm_status = 'RESELECT_REQUIRED' and o.reselection_from_transfer_id is not null
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_STOCK_CHECK_EXECUTE' as type, 'execution' as category, s.check_id as business_id, s.check_no as business_no, case when s.deadline < current_timestamp then concat('盘点已逾期：', s.check_no) when timestampdiff(second, current_timestamp, s.deadline) <= #{stockCheckDueSoonHours} * 3600 then concat('盘点即将到期：', s.check_no) else concat('待执行盘点：', s.check_no) end collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, concat('盘点人：', coalesce(nullif(s.counter_name, ''), '未命名'), '；截止：', date_format(s.deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, case when s.deadline < current_timestamp then 'overdue' when timestampdiff(second, current_timestamp, s.deadline) <= #{stockCheckDueSoonHours} * 3600 then 'due_soon' else 'pending' end as status, case when s.deadline < current_timestamp then 'urgent' when timestampdiff(second, current_timestamp, s.deadline) <= #{stockCheckDueSoonHours} * 3600 then 'important' else 'normal' end as priority, coalesce(s.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(s.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'input' as route_type, 'inv:stockCheck:submit' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_stock_check s inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id where s.status = 'draft' and s.counter_user_id = #{userId} and s.deadline is not null
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_STOCK_CHECK_RETURNED' as type, 'returned' as category, s.check_id as business_id, s.check_no as business_no, concat('盘点已退回：', s.check_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, coalesce(nullif(s.last_reject_reason, ''), '审批驳回，请修改后重新提交') collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, s.status as status, 'important' as priority, coalesce(s.last_rejected_time, s.update_time, s.create_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(s.last_rejected_time, s.update_time, s.create_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'revise' as route_type, 'inv:stockCheck:submit' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_stock_check s inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id where ( s.status = 'returned' or ( s.status = 'rejected' and coalesce(s.approval_engine, 'LEGACY') = 'LEGACY' ) ) and coalesce(s.counter_user_id, s.submitted_user_id) = #{userId}
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_STOCK_CHECK_RESTART' as type, 'returned' as category, s.check_id as business_id, s.check_no as business_no, concat('重新盘点：', s.check_no) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, coalesce(nullif(s.last_invalid_reason, ''), '库存快照已变化，请重新盘点') collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, s.status as status, 'important' as priority, coalesce(s.last_invalidated_time, current_timestamp) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, coalesce(s.last_invalidated_time, current_timestamp), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'restart' as route_type, 'inv:stockCheck:submit' as required_permission, 1 as count_value from inv_stock_check s inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id where s.status = 'invalidated' and coalesce(s.counter_user_id, s.submitted_user_id) = #{userId}
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_OUT_OF_STOCK' as type, 'risk' as category, st.shop_dept_id as business_id, concat('ORG-', st.shop_dept_id) as business_no, concat(context_dept.dept_name, '缺货预警') collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, convert(concat('缺货商品：', count(distinct st.product_id), ' 种') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, 'out_of_stock' as status, 'urgent' as priority, min(coalesce(st.update_time, st.create_time, current_timestamp)) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, min(coalesce(st.update_time, st.create_time, current_timestamp)), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'view_risk' as route_type, 'inv:stock:list' as required_permission, count(distinct st.product_id) as count_value from inv_stock st inner join inv_product p on p.product_id = st.product_id inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = st.shop_dept_id where coalesce(st.available_quantity, st.current_quantity, 0) <= 0
group by st.shop_dept_id, context_dept.dept_id, context_dept.dept_name, context_dept.dept_type
union all select 'inventory' as source, 'INV_LOW_STOCK' as type, 'risk' as category, st.shop_dept_id as business_id, concat('ORG-', st.shop_dept_id) as business_no, concat(context_dept.dept_name, '低库存预警') collate utf8mb4_general_ci as title, convert(concat('低库存商品：', count(distinct st.product_id), ' 种') using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as summary, 'low_stock' as status, 'normal' as priority, min(coalesce(st.update_time, st.create_time, current_timestamp)) as created_time, greatest(timestampdiff(second, min(coalesce(st.update_time, st.create_time, current_timestamp)), current_timestamp), 0) as waiting_seconds, context_dept.dept_id as dept_id, context_dept.dept_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_name, context_dept.dept_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as dept_type, as scope_mode, 'view_risk' as route_type, 'inv:stock:list' as required_permission, count(distinct st.product_id) as count_value from inv_stock st inner join inv_product p on p.product_id = st.product_id inner join sys_dept context_dept on context_dept.dept_id = st.shop_dept_id where coalesce(st.available_quantity, st.current_quantity, 0) > 0 and coalesce(st.available_quantity, st.current_quantity, 0) <= coalesce(p.safety_stock_min, 10)
group by st.shop_dept_id, context_dept.dept_id, context_dept.dept_name, context_dept.dept_type

if.test: query != null and query.type != null and query.type != ''
query != null and query.category != null and query.category != ''
query != null and query.priority != null and query.priority != ''
query != null and query.keyword != null and query.keyword != ''

where.if: and ( business_no like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or title like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or summary like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
